AnimEntitySingleAnimLoop::vf20 (CrewChief's too): reached only from the post-update list (+0x2c54), which holds entities with +0x28 set; only the land animals' constructor sets it (build_scene_anim_roaming.c), the scene loader clears it (build_scene.c)

network-object events (NetVehicle / NetPlayer updates, Quazal DuplicatedObject / VDOHandle, net timers / login): only the online session layer posts them (net_boundary.h: fatal in the product by design), so these proxies are never invoked offline

BehaviorRoamTrack::vf4: only Freestyle drivers get the behaviour (rx_freestyle_stub_vf47), and a Freestyle driver's behaviours run only in the AI riding 0050d240, which needs the AI debug override 0xae1b90 (MXRegistry TuneAI, F in the shipped MXRegistry.xml) and is itself a DEBUG BOUNDARY (race_freestyle_driver.c act_unreached); the 12-rider Freestyle traces reach the behaviour's vf3 / vf6, never vf4

MXSeriesEventFreestyle::vf13: no Series row of the shipped career data has the Freestyle format (Freestyle events are SingleEvent rows: MXSeriesEventSingle; career_series_test list), and the product does not compose that format either (career_composition.c composed_event -> 0, rx_career_composition_format_supported refuses it), so no AdvancePostEvent reaches a Freestyle series event (50 KB of the original behind it: a feature, not a stub)

LuaAssetIO::vf4: no LuaAsset can exist: the product builds assets only through the g_types loaders (build_asset.c / build_load.c) and "script" has none (the Lua VM is not ported, build_mxgame_startup.c), so the asset stays 0
asset - 0x460 is the BXMLAsset object itself (its IAsset sub-object sits at +0x460): the call reads the primary vtable, whose slot 0 is 00822170 (ported), not the +0x460 thunk 0082af30

NetworkSnakeBoundaryChanged (void(float)): raised only by the network snake object's update (Quazal NetSnake, online); the offline session posts none, so the party modes' listener proxies are never invoked offline (race_infection.c, race_snake.c: ONLINE)
